name: Leopalace21 Corporation
summary: Leopalace21 Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction, leasing, and sale of apartments, condominiums, and residential housing in Japan. It operates in three segments: Rental Business, Senior Care Business, and Other Businesses. The Rental Business segment is involved in the leasing and management of apartment rooms buildings and other properties; maintenance work; a solar power generation business; and real estate brokerage activities. This segment also provides broadband and company housing agency services, as well as small-amount short-term insurance. The Senior Care Business segment operates nursing care facilities.
